scope: Authenticated coherent authored-profile/resource projection, immutable revision pinning and validated frontend assembly. Installed frontend and all five complete editions remain open.

unexecuted_attempts.reason: Coordinator stopped while capturing artifact identities before launching a test; no product test outcome claimed.

later_change_verification: The first build stopped on misleading indentation under -Werror; formatting was corrected. The next coordinator stopped before tests because a copied artifact list named generated/profile_projection.hpp instead of generated/helper_identity.hpp. Its source archive and coordinator trace remain preserved. Final review tightened ordered capability and exact closure validation and added a self-consistent malformed-header rejection within the frozen corruption family. Frozen package/case/expected startup/command bytes are unchanged. Each executed run retains exact source inputs; later_changes records subsequent edits. Final native and regression artifacts agree. After execution, specctl updates only the generated navigation indexes in contracts and valid/invalid fixtures; code, schemas and actual fixture bytes remain the tested inputs.
limitations: Native transfer evidence covers the shipped profile in the non-root ext4 laboratory; maximum-size native transfer throughput is not qualified.
Large/binary/empty resource assembly is tested portably; it does not qualify installed GUI behavior.
ProfileDownload requires an already authenticated native connection and caller invalidation/erasure on transport, producer or policy loss.
Positive native policy is a dedicated test fixture; protected-policy deployment remains unqualified.
Actual frontend scheduling, deployment/data/runtime ownership, other private helper identities, UI/telemetry/activation/recovery/import composition remain open.
Windows shared builds and checks do not qualify Windows 9x/NT historical runtime behavior, and all five complete desktop editions retain their release/lifecycle gates.
